newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures break down to big loss.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures break down to big loss.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures broke down to a big loss, new session low. Brokers said they saw continued evidence of asset allocation plays, with two dealers in particular today seen selling S&P 500 futures, buying bond futures. Locals also liquidated longs before Friday's April US jobs report, though some bids began to emerge. They said 795.50-25 could hold. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
